title: Ripple Price Analysis: XRP Rejected at Key Resistance Again – Is $1.00 Next?
summary: XRP had recovered toward $1.34 after briefly dipping near $1.20 last week before it dumped to $1.26 minutes ago, with the latest push lifting the token above the upper boundary of its short-term descending channel on the 4-hour chart.
